actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.

actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

actions.get_trends.props.count.descripti: Number of trends to return. Use 1-50.
actions.get_trends.props.woeid.descripti: Yahoo Where On Earth ID. Use 1 for worldwide, 23424977 for US, 23424975 for UK, or 23424969 for Turkey.

actions.get_user.description: Look up a public X/Twitter user by username or user ID
actions.get_user.props.user.description: Username with or without @, or a numeric user ID.

actions.get_user_tweets.props.cursor.des: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
actions.get_user_tweets.props.includePar: Include parent post context when available.
actions.get_user_tweets.props.includeRep: Include reply posts in the timeline response.

actions.search_tweets.props.query.descri: Search query. Supports keywords, hashtags, from:user, exact phrases, and X search operators.

actions.search_tweets.props.untilTime.de: Only return posts before this ISO timestamp.
